versions.changelog:
opc-customer-acquisition-platform v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launched the core OPC customer acquisition sub-contracting platform for end-to-end project collaboration, including project posting, bidding, modular subcontracting, signing, delivery, settlement, and evaluation.
- Provides a matching mechanism based on community trust, group pricing, and capability profiling for efficient business collaboration within the OPC ecosystem.
- Introduces standardized project grading, transparent income sharing, credit dual-track system, and milestone-based delivery management.
- Includes comprehensive step-by-step operational guidelines for all key project phases.
